user.title: Choose the device
user.description: Pick the ESPHome Device Builder configuration that is built from a Git repository. Each device is added separately.

details.title: Where {device} gets its code
details.description: An update is offered whenever the branch has a commit the device is not running. Install builds the device in ESPHome Device Builder and uploads it.

data.revision_entity: Sensor with the commit the device runs
data.token: Access token (only for a private repository)
data.ignored_files: Changes that need no new build

data_description.revision_entity: A text sensor on the device that reports the Git commit it was built from, e.g. 1a2b3c4.
data_description.token: A read-only token, sent only over https and only to this server. Leave empty for a public repository. When reconfiguring, leave empty to keep the saved token (only while the server stays the same).
data_description.ignored_files: Optional. One file pattern per line, e.g. *.md or docs/. A commit that only changes matching files is not offered as an update. * also matches /, and a pattern ending in / matches a whole folder.

reauth_confirm.title: New access token for {device}
reauth_confirm.description: Gitea refused the access token for {repo_url}: it is wrong, has expired or was removed. Enter a new read-only token, or leave the field empty if the repository is now public.

error.cannot_read_repo: Could not read that branch. Check the address, branch and token.
error.invalid_repo: That is not a repository address (http or https, ending in owner/repository) or a valid branch name.
error.token_needs_https: A token is only sent over an encrypted connection. Use the repository's https address, or leave the token empty for a public repository.
error.invalid_patterns: Use at most 50 patterns, one per line, each up to 200 characters.
error.invalid_auth: Gitea refused the access token. Check it, or create a new one with repository: read.
error.other_device: That sensor belongs to another ESPHome device. Pick the sensor of the device that is built from this configuration.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.all_configured: Every ESPHome Device Builder device is already set up.
abort.no_device_builder: ESPHome Device Builder is not connected to Home Assistant. Install the ESPHome Device Builder app and make sure Home Assistant's ESPHome integration finds it.

no_device_builder.message: ESPHome Device Builder is not available.

unknown_configuration.message: ESPHome Device Builder has no configuration {configuration}.

build_failed.message: Building {configuration} failed. See the ESPHome Device Builder log.

upload_failed.message: Uploading to {device} failed. See the ESPHome Device Builder log.
